name: NextVector
description: High-signal AI news, sourced model data, public leaderboards (arena.ai, OSWorld-Verified, SWE-bench Verified), model showdowns, and buyer guides. Primary sources linked, no marketing fluff.

editorialCharter.manifesto: Less noise. More signal. Sourced benchmarks over marketing claims.
editorialCharter.evaluationFramework: The Three Questions: What happened? Why does it matter? What could happen next?
editorialCharter.signalPurityScale: 1-100 deterministic scoring based on architectural novelty, benchmark verification, engineering utility, and source reliability.

coverageAreas: Artificial Intelligence (Foundation Models, LLMs, Reasoning Systems, Autonomous Agents)
Computing & Hardware (Semiconductors, Lithography, Quantum Computing, Datacenter Fabrics)
Fundamental Science (Astrophysics, Quantum Mechanics, Computational Biology)
Public Benchmarks (arena.ai text leaderboard, OSWorld-Verified, SWE-bench Verified)

modelPicks.method: Each pick applies a stated rule to public data (arena.ai text leaderboard, Artificial Analysis indexes, OSWorld-Verified, SWE-bench Verified, list prices). NextVector does not run these tests.

picks.rule: Highest arena.ai text score among generally released models we track.
Highest Arena score with a blended list price under $1 per 1M tokens (3 input : 1 output).
Highest Arena score with a blended list price under $0.20 per 1M tokens.
Highest Arena score among models with downloadable weights.
Highest OSWorld-Verified success rate (General model runs) among models we track.
Highest SWE-bench Verified score in mini-SWE-agent runs. These runs stop in early 2026, so newer models are missing.
Highest Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index among generally released models we track (best setting per model).
Highest Artificial Analysis Coding Index among generally released models we track (best setting per model).
Highest Artificial Analysis Agentic Index among generally released models we track (best setting per model).
Largest listed context window among Arena-ranked models; ties go to the higher Arena score.
